coaching.headline: Ten structures to two and all three Fangtooths, but seven straight enemy kills after the Orb Prime shrank a stomp to a one-kill fucking lead.
coaching.team: Bayle drew first blood on Iggy & Scorch, the team drew level at one apiece and never trailed again, finishing twenty-seven to twenty-one on kills. The team took all three Fangtooths, both Mini Primes, the Orb Prime, two of three Genesis Cores and ten structures while losing two outer towers; the enemy took both Primal Fangtooths. After the Orb Prime the enemy scored seven straight kills and took the second Primal Fangtooth and a Genesis Core before five unanswered allied kills, two inhibitors and the Core ended the game.

focus.title: Spend the Orb Prime on structures
focus.action: Once the Orb Prime is taken with an enemy inhibitor already down, call the next structure and walk in together behind an allied minion wave. No side fights until that structure falls; seven straight deaths with the enemy base open is a gift.

17.2.call: Gadget killed Iggy & Scorch, Kira killed Eden and Adele, and Greystone killed Bayle. The fight went 3-1, an enemy inner tower fell shortly after and the Mini Prime went to the team soon after that. Win the fight, then cash the structure.

27.7.call: Iggy & Scorch died outside any detected fight and the enemy took the second Primal Fangtooth shortly after. In the next fight Eden killed Greystone and Gadget killed Phase and Kira, with no enemy deaths. The fight went 0-3, and the enemy added a Genesis Core later in the same run.

31.8.call: Iggy & Scorch killed Eden, Greystone killed Adele and Kira killed Crunch with no allied deaths. The fight went 3-0, two enemy inhibitors fell in the same window and the enemy Core went down right after. Five unanswered kills across the last two fights ended the enemy run.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 ran Kira like a proper fucking carry: the second-most kills, hero damage and objective damage in the game, hero damage per minute well above the recorded Kira norm, and Eden and Adele dead to Kira five times.

Eden killed Kira three times, more than any enemy managed on any single ally. When Eden swaps into the claws with Zero Shift, Kira saves Shadow Glide for the exit instead of spending the dash to start the trade.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 did the support job on Phase: the most healing and the most assists in the game, a hand in nearly half the team's kills, and ward placements right on the recorded Phase norm. Proper nurse shit.

Phase was the team's first death in two fights, and Adele got Phase twice. With Adele in range, Phase holds Phase Blink for the Imperial Lash root; landing Psychic Flare on a hero shortens that Blink cooldown.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a: notbutafish ran a heavy jungle game on Kwang: the most objective damage and damage mitigated in the game, deaths under the recorded Kwang norm, and all three Fangtooths, both Mini Primes and the Orb Prime to the team.

One ward placed is far under the recorded Kwang norm, a jungler wandering around with the lights off. If wards were equipped and sat unused, Kwang swaps to sentry next game and sweeps before each Primal Fangtooth.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64: Iggy & Scorch was the best player in this lobby: most kills, hero damage and gold in the game, hero damage per minute far above the recorded norm, and Bayle torched six times. A walking fucking bonfire.

Seven deaths led the team, two outside any detected fight, and the enemy took the second Primal Fangtooth soon after the later one. Security Gate roots whoever walks through, so Iggy & Scorch steps around the gate, never through.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070: candres507Pty-cd buried Crunch on Greystone: three kills on Crunch for one in return, the fewest deaths on the team, and hero damage per minute well above the recorded Greystone norm. Nothing soft about that shit.

Two deaths while soaking the second-most damage on the team is the standard now. When Crunch jumps a shooter, Greystone answers with Assault The Gates, since a hero hit cuts the leap cooldown for the next engage.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Kira and Phase faced carry Eden and support Adele. Eden swaps stances with Zero Shift, healing on hero damage in the claws, and built Terminus, which turns lifesteal overhealing into a shield, and Ruination, which drains mana and deals true damage from the mana drained. Adele built Frostguard, which cuts the attack speed of any basic attacker hitting Adele, plus Dawnstar and Xenia. The enemy duo died four times before the ten-minute mark and the allied duo twice. Kira killed Eden three times and Adele twice; Eden killed Kira three times. Across the match Gadget was the top enemy damage dealer.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Solaris empowers the basic attack after each ability cast, can critically strike and heals for part of the damage. Ashbringer cuts non-ultimate cooldowns on basic attacks, more on critical strikes, so Mercy and Dusk come back faster. Imperator raises critical strike damage, and Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks with on-hit damage that grows as the target's health drops, aimed at Eden's melee-stance healing and Bayle, the biggest enemy healer. Every completed item adds critical chance, and Mercy and Purge can both critically strike. None of the four adds armor against an enemy team with four physical damage dealers.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis adds maximum-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero, and Serration adds missing-health damage to that hit, which suits finishing targets. Melting Point only adds damage against targets above a high physical armor threshold, and Adele, with Dawnstar, Xenia and Frostguard, was the only enemy carrying a flat physical armor item. Breach is the second-minor alternative: Purge damage would shred physical armor on every hero caught in the torrent, trading the threshold bonus for a shred Greystone can also use.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Siphoning Purge makes Purge heal Kira for part of the damage dealt to heroes, and Purge already cuts enemy healing while the torrent lands, so the channel doubles as sustain and anti-heal. Shadow Glide can be cast during Purge, which keeps an exit available mid-channel. Bringer Of Mercy is the alternative, cutting Mercy's mana cost and shaving current cooldowns when Mercy deals damage, trading channel sustain for more frequent shots. Healing from Purge is not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes a short distance and empowers the next physical damage instance, hitting much harder on targets at low health, and a hero kill soon after allows a recast. Kira's damage is physical, so the empowered hit applies to Wrath and Mercy. The crest's lifesteal also feeds Purge and Mercy, which both benefit from lifesteal. Activations and resets are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Kira built the full winning core of Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator, plus Tainted Rounds. Eden accounted for three of Kira's four deaths, so the next item is the place to compare Draconum, which adds physical armor, physical power and a heal on takedowns, against another critical strike item, trading damage for survival against physical burst. With hero damage per minute well above the recorded Kira norm, the current four items are a sound keep.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Phase and Kira faced support Adele and carry Eden. Adele roots and dashes with Imperial Lash, mesmerizes with Royal Flourish and roots an area with Queen's Garden, and Court of Roses makes Iron Rose also give the nearest ally a damage-reduction barrier. Adele killed Phase twice, and Bayle, Eden and Gadget killed Phase once each. The allied duo died twice before the ten-minute mark and the enemy duo four times. Across the match Gadget was the top enemy damage dealer, dealing magical damage.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Prophecy adds attack speed and on-hit damage to Phase's own basic attacks. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, which Psychic Flare and Energy Lance deal, and builds Malice stacks for extra ability damage on heroes. Galaxy Greaves adds both armors, mana regeneration and haste, with a higher jump after moving and bonus movement speed out of combat, and was the only completed allied item with a flat magical armor stat against Gadget. All four other allies also carried an anti-heal item, so Tainted Scepter's healing cut overlapped with the team.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Exarch gives a healed or shielded target attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage, which pairs with Essence Catalyst healing Phase and the linked ally after every cast. Preservation increases healing and shielding Phase receives, and Fervour heals Phase and nearby allies on basic attacks against enemy heroes, which suits Prophecy's on-hit build. Revelation is the first-minor alternative, cutting basic ability cooldowns on each cast, trading self-healing for more Psychic Flare and Energy Lance casts.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst also restore the linked ally's missing mana. Kira, Kwang and Iggy & Scorch all carried mana items, so any Link target could use the refill. Kindred Surge is the alternative, adding movement speed and health regeneration during Hyperflux, trading mana support for a faster, safer fight window. Final Flash shortens Energy Lance for more damage. The Link target and mana restored are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Tranquility's Grace heals Phase and nearby heroes and adds brief damage mitigation, the crest pays passive gold each second while minion gold diminishes, and the ward cap rises. Phase's ward placements sat right on the recorded Phase norm. Enemy healing reduction from Eden's Tainted Rounds and Gadget's Tainted Scepter cuts the heal side of Grace. Activations are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: The winning core is Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves; Phase built only Galaxy Greaves. Enra's Blessing shields a nearby ally who gets immobilized, against Security Gate, Imperial Lash, Queen's Garden, Crunch's stuns and Bayle's Cursed Edge, at the cost of Tainted Scepter's anti-heal, already covered by all four other allies. Marshal buffs Phase and nearby allies with attack speed and on-hit damage, which suits Kira, at the cost of Prophecy's personal attack speed and on-hit damage. A won game proves neither swap.

5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.matchup: Kwang's jungle opponent was Bayle, who leaps and shreds physical armor with Skull Crusher, stuns with the third Cursed Edge slash, heals with Dire Howl and dashes in with Kingslayer. Bayle built Void Helm, adding magical armor and stronger healing against Kwang's mostly magical kit, and Basilisk, shredding physical armor on hero damage. Bayle had the most deaths and the second-most healing in the game. Kwang and Bayle killed each other once apiece, and Kwang's other kill was Eden. Across the match Gadget was the top enemy damage dealer.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.build: Spirit Of Amir adds magical lifesteal in the jungle, more magical power outside the jungle and extra ability damage to monsters. Oathkeeper empowers the basic attack after each ability cast, pairing with the energized basics from Strike of the Heavens. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, aimed at Bayle's Dire Howl heal and the Void Helm boost, and Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power. The full winning core of Spirit Of Amir, Oathkeeper and Tainted Scepter was built. None of the four adds armor against four physical damage dealers, while Kwang took the most damage on the team.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability damage to heroes. Lich adds magical lifesteal by level, and Phylactery speeds cooldowns after Fury of the Heavens and grants a shield based on maximum mana, which Oathkeeper raises. Tithe of Death is the first-minor alternative, restoring mana and granting permanent ability haste on takedowns, trading Lich's sustain for faster casts. With the most damage taken on the team, Lich is the sound keep.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.augment: Slayer of the Heavens makes Strike of the Heavens hit harder and cut basic ability cooldowns further, so each energized basic attack that hits a hero brings Judgement, Surge and Light of the Heavens back sooner. Aura of the Heavens is the alternative, adding omnivamp for Kwang and a smaller share for nearby allies, trading the cooldown engine for sustain the team shares. Cooldown savings are not recorded.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.crest: Tempest's Overcharge damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals for part of the damage, which fits a jungler who stays in the brawl and took the most damage on the team. Repeat hits on the same target deal far less, so Tempest pays most with several enemies close. Enemy anti-heal from Eden's Tainted Rounds and Gadget's Tainted Scepter cuts the heal. Activations are not recorded.
5f1840de-9b6a-4c93-a04b-ad52ecaf116a.improvement: Kwang built the full winning core plus Oblivion Crown. Golem's Gift is the comparison for the Crown slot: magical power, physical armor, mana regeneration and haste, with armor stacks gained out of combat, lost on physical hits from heroes and restored on ability casts, against four physical damage dealers. The cost is Oblivion Crown's raw magical power and multiplier. With the most objective damage and mitigation in the game and deaths under the recorded Kwang norm, the current build is a sound keep.

cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.matchup: Iggy & Scorch's mid opponent was Gadget, who roots with Security Gate, slows with Seek and Destroy and drops Tesla Dome, which shreds magical armor and slows. Gadget built Overseer, so Tesla Dome hits harder and heals Gadget, plus Tainted Scepter, which cuts Magnify's omnivamp healing. Gadget was the top enemy damage dealer, dealing magical damage. Iggy & Scorch killed Gadget three times and Gadget killed Iggy & Scorch twice. Across the match Bayle drew first blood on Iggy & Scorch and died to Iggy & Scorch six times.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.build: Soulbinder adds ability damage on heroes hit from long range, Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power, and Azure Core shields at low health and grows mana from unit kills toward extra power. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, aimed at Bayle, the biggest enemy healer, and Gadget's Overseer. Magnify adds omnivamp and shreds magical armor on ability hits, and Wraith Leggings adds magical penetration and ability damage on low-health heroes, useful into Bayle's Void Helm and Adele's Xenia and Frostguard. No completed item adds armor.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.eternal: Aion adds mana regeneration on casts and pays gold from spell damage to heroes, which lines up with the most hero damage and the most gold in the game. Bottomless Vial pays on river buff kills, which are not credited per player. Runic Focus adds magical power from current mana, fed by the mana on Soulbinder and Azure Core. Sacrifice is the first-minor alternative, regenerating missing mana on ability hits and hero kills, which suits the most kills in the game, trading the river-buff reward.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.augment: Turret Maniac raises the turret cap to four at the cost of turret health. Flame Turrets take extra damage from melee basic attacks, and Crunch and Bayle are melee, so the thinner turrets are easier to clear in a brawl. Hold This! is the alternative, permanently growing Molotov's explosion damage each time the explosion hits a hero, trading turret count for damage that cannot be knocked down. Turret uptime is not recorded.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.crest: Epoch enters stasis to wait out incoming damage, the main defensive button in a build with no armor. With the most deaths on the team, holding stasis for Tesla Dome, Kingslayer or Eden's Limit Break is the obvious use. Stasis gives no distance, so Blink is still the exit afterward. Activations are not recorded.
cf1ee944-2d13-4076-9648-f25cec1e0f64.improvement: The winning core is Orb Of Growth, Entropy and Megacosm; Iggy & Scorch built none of the three. Megacosm deals maximum-health and bonus-health damage on ability hits, aimed at the health items on Bayle and Crunch, and Soulbinder is the slot to compare since that bonus needs long-range hits. Five of the seven deaths came from heroes other than Gadget, so Golem's Gift, with magical power and physical armor, is the defensive comparison at the cost of raw power. With the most kills, hero damage and gold in the game, the build is a sound keep.

104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.matchup: Greystone's offlane opponent was Crunch, who dashes and stuns with Forward Crunch, knocks up with the empowered Right Crunch and heals on every third hit through Re-Crunch. Crunch built Vyzar Carapace, Tyranny, Volcanica, Augmentation and Rapture: health and damage with no armor item. Greystone killed Crunch three times and Crunch killed Greystone once, with one kill each in the same two-hero exchange. Across the match Eden had the most enemy kills and Gadget the most enemy hero damage.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.build: Overlord cleaves damage around the target on basic attacks and grows health from kills. Tainted Blade cuts healing on physical damage, which is all of Greystone's damage, aimed at Re-Crunch and Bayle; ability damage on a blighted target adds a damage-taken debuff. Aegis Of Agawar raises both armors by a percentage, more below a health threshold, Salvation shields with omnivamp at low health and adds tenacity against Crunch's stuns, and Augmentation empowers the basic attack after each ability cast. No completed item carries a flat armor stat for Aegis to scale.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.eternal: Krix adds maximum health and size. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, and Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns. Festering Wounds is not needed here: all five allied players already carried an anti-heal item. Feeding Frenzy is the second-minor alternative, adding attack speed per nearby enemy hero, trading permanent health for faster Overlord cleaves in a crowded fight.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.augment: Close Cut makes Make Way deal more damage to the nearest enemy unit, which suits the close fights with Crunch, and Make Way already shreds physical armor for Kira and Greystone. Imperial Soul is the alternative, making Stone Forged Soul hit harder in a larger radius, trading single-target pressure for teamfight area. Tainted Oath adds blight to Sacred Oath, which overlaps with Tainted Blade. Damage by target is not recorded.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver damages nearby enemies and heals on the first hero hit, with weaker heals on further hero hits, and the crest adds physical power, health and omnivamp. That suits the second-most damage taken on the team and pairs with Salvation's low-health omnivamp. Enemy anti-heal from Eden's Tainted Rounds and Gadget's Tainted Scepter cuts the heal. Activations are not recorded.
104d5b47-1cb6-4958-9ab1-70dc8bd72070.improvement: The winning core is Overlord, Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar; Greystone built Salvation and Augmentation instead of Rapture. Rapture adds attack speed, health, omnivamp and on-hit damage near enemies, at the cost of Salvation's tenacity and low-health shield. Citadel is the armor comparison for the Augmentation slot: flat physical armor, more per nearby enemy hero, and less physical armor on nearby enemies, trading Augmentation's attack speed, haste and empowered basic. With two deaths, the current build is a sound keep.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 5 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
ourKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
ourKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her
